subject: sarcastic fringehead
title: This Fish Fights With a Kiss, and the Loser Loses His Home

scenes.text: This fish fights with a kiss. Nobody's in love.
It's a sarcastic fringehead, about a foot long, and it backs into a shell on the Pacific seafloor.
When a rival swims near, it flares its jaws wide open, showing a bright yellow mouth.
Then the two males press their open mouths together and shove, until one gives up and swims away.
The winner keeps the den and the chance to mate. The loser is evicted.
So that kiss is really a wrestling match.

description:

Rival male sarcastic fringeheads, fish that grow up to about a foot long off California and Baja, press their wide-open mouths together until one gives up and swims away. The winner keeps the den and the chance to mate.
Would you rather fight with a kiss or a handshake?

first_comment: Its name is real: it is the sarcastic fringehead. Would you have guessed that mouth belongs to a fish under a foot long?
